recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, theatrical composition featuring two women in dark clothing posed against a backdrop of deep purple velvet curtains and ornate gold-framed mirrors. The lighting is dramatic and directional, creating high contrast and a slightly grainy, filmic texture characteristic of mid-90s pop photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between deep purple textiles and bright outdoor light through a window
Integration of large-scale, textured typography with the foreground and background elements
coreInvariants: Deep purple velvet curtains with gold tassels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two female figures; one seated centrally in the foreground, one standing slightly behind and to the left, creating a diagonal depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure and the large gold title in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right gold text, moves down to the central figure's face, follows her leg line to the bottom text, and circles back through the standing figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with curtains, mirrors, and architectural details.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark interior and bright exterior light; saturated purples against muted, earthy skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, slightly distressed edges on the gold lettering
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the bottom text is replaced or overlaid with a circular graphic element containing a cross-like structure.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, textured gold top text and geometric, beveled bottom text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the top text.
Matches the slab-serif structure of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast photograph of two women in black 90s fashion. One sits on a wooden chair, the other stands behind. They are framed by heavy purple velvet curtains and a large gold mirror. Bright daylight streams in from a window in the background. The image has a slight film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, 3D textured gold sans-serif text in the upper right, partially tucked behind the hair of the central figure. Add beveled burgundy slab-serif text at the bottom center with a circular graphic replacing the central letter.

verificationChecks: Is the purple velvet rich and deep?
Does the gold text have a tangible 3D texture?
Is the lighting high-contrast with a 90s film look?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the models
Exact brand logos or specific trademarked emblems

avoid: Overly bright, saturated modern digital colors

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple curtains dominate the color palette
Verify the high-contrast lighting doesn't wash out the skin tones
Confirm the text placement respects the subject hierarchy
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine theatrical interior photography (purple velvet, mirrors) with heavy, textured 3D display typography to create a mid-90s pop aesthetic.
